_comment: NPC dialogue for high_warden_isolde (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The Warden-kin hold Skyreach. They have been expecting someone carrying warm shards for a long time, and they are not happy about it.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Reach Visited Skyreach. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Isolde tells you what a Warden is: a promise made into a person, and a promise can be broken.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Speak with High Warden Isolde. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Three rime cores, so the Citadel's forge can burn cold enough to unmake warden steel.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 3 Rime Core. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: A vault sealed with ice that was once a door. Isolde's grandmother helped seal it; Isolde wants to know why.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Reach Entered Rimevault. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: A giant has been standing at the vault door since the ash came north. It has not eaten, and it has not moved.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 1 Jorunn the Frost Giant. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Six hollow relics out of the vault, all of them older than the door they were sealed behind.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 6 Hollow Relic. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The switchback up to Warden's Ascent is held by trolls. Isolde's scouts counted ten before they stopped counting.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 10 Rime Troll. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Five rime cores, for the one forge in the peaks that can still work them.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 5 Rime Core. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Isolde is reopening the old road to Warden's Ascent and the revenants have opinions about it.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 8 Frost Revenant. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Skyreach's scouts have not reported in for nine days. Clear whatever is sitting on their route.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 12 Rime Troll. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Ten revenants walking in file, none of them armed, all of them in Citadel grey. Isolde wants to know what they think they are marching to.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 10 Frost Revenant. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The mile of road under the Citadel is walked by revenants in Citadel grey. Isolde wants to know which of her people they were.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 12 Frost Revenant. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Six ward stones for the Citadel gate -- the last six, if the Choir's archons are counting the same way Isolde is.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 6 Frost Crystal. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The switchback climb to the Citadel's undercroft. Isolde will not walk it; she says Wardens do not enter each other's graves.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Reach Entered Wardens Ascent. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The switchback has to be broken behind you, and the trolls are in the way of the picks.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 14 Rime Troll. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Eight frost crystals to light the Citadel's gate wards one more time, for the people who will come back down this road without you.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 8 Frost Crystal. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Sixteen trolls on the last of the switchback, with the ring warm underneath them and the snow steaming off the stone.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 16 Rime Troll. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Five ingots of warden steel, drawn from the Choir's own store, to reforge the Citadel's broken gate.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 5 Warden-Steel Ingot. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Four more of the Choir's ledgers, for the archive wing that is only opened for endings.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 4 Choir Ledger. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Five heralds left, and every one of them is carrying the Warden's seal.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 5 Ashen Herald. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Three Ashen Heralds, all carrying the same sealed order, all addressed to you by name.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 3 Ashen Herald. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: The scorched ring, and under it the keep where the first promise is still being kept. Isolde's last order is one word: descend.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Reach Entered Ember Warden Keep. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Fourteen archons between you and the stair down. Nobody is singing now.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Slay 14 Ashen Archon. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Six Choir sigils, unbroken, for the Citadel's archive. The archive has a wing that is only opened for endings.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 6 Choir Sigil. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Six ingots left at the citadel, so the road back is a road and not a walk into nothing.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Gather 6 Warden-Steel Ingot. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: High Warden Isolde
1.text: Isolde stands like a wall that has been asked a question.

3.speaker: High Warden Isolde
3.text: A knot in the ground and a promise built around it. Cut one and you will be left holding the other, and it will be your hand.

4.speaker: High Warden Isolde
4.text: Enough that it is no longer counted. I stopped writing them down because the list was being read as a war, and it is not a war.

5.speaker: High Warden Isolde
5.text: Eventually: everything. Right now: whatever you are carrying that still answers when you call it.

2.speaker: High Warden Isolde
2.text: Go on. I have the time, which is the only thing anyone in this valley still has in quantity.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

barks.text: A binding is a promise made with violence. Promises can be broken other ways.
The vessel is not the enemy. That distinction is the whole of our work.
Skyreach sees the smoke before the fire. This year, there is a great deal of smoke.
